The input is a plausible, coherent planning request, and the output is a natural, well-organized prompt that does not perform the task. However, it omits the explicit requirements to mark planned dinners as vegetarian or fish and to identify anything that must be made ahead. Asking for vegetarian/fish meals and brief prep notes does not preserve those labeling requirements. It also drops “Don’t add other dietary rules” and Eli’s supplied quotation, “please don't make every meal a project.” These omissions violate /prompt’s requirement to preserve supplied material and constraints.
